messages:
Jules R: Need a compact benchmark narrative + hero visuals for launch. Focus: latency impact on UX and unit-cost deltas across deployments. 3-slide hero + CTA.
Hannah T: Audience = infra PMs and platform teams. Keep language product-forward, not too academic.
Omar N: Charts we should include: 1) scatter: p95 latency vs $/1k tokens by deployment; 2) bar: $/1k tokens across quant levels; 3) tiny flow: hosted -> dedicated -> private with cost buckets.
Vik P: Quick numbers for mockups (rounded): chat hosted p95 170ms, dedicated p95 50ms; cost/1k hosted $0.035, dedicated $0.007. Completions longer: hosted p95 420ms, dedicated 160ms; cost/1k hosted $0.06, dedicated $0.012.
Jules R: Nice. Messaging options for hero: A) "Keep users fast. Cut inference cost." B) "Predictable inference: low latency, lower unit cost." Which is punchier?
Hannah T: A for social, B for webinar registration. We'll A/B test.
DesignBot: Color mapping: hosted=blue, dedicated=green, private=purple. Use a 200ms vertical line on latency chart labeled "interactive".
Omar N: I'll produce a small CSV for the charting lib. Example rows:
```
workload,deploy,p95_ms,cost_per_1k,throughput
chat,hosted,170,0.035,14
chat,dedicated,50,0.007,48
completions,hosted,420,0.06,4
completions,dedicated,160,0.012,18
```
Vik P: Add a tiny fallback example: rare model cold-start p95 +300ms to justify routing policies.
Jules R: CTA copy: primary "See the benchmarks" secondary "Request a dedicated trial". Lead qualifier: trial + >100k tokens in 30 days or dedicated request.
Hannah T: Action items: Omar CSV + mock charts by EOD, DesignBot to sketch hero tomorrow AM, Vik to confirm numbers with infra. Sync at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
